data.title: 春原瞬 · 竹影月台的晚风侧颜
data.description: 高悬于山海经楼阁之上的露天竹影月台，夜空皎洁如银的圆月洒下清辉。瞬迎风而立，单手握着一把精巧的泥金折扇半遮朱唇，长达脚踝的如墨青丝在夜风中徐徐飘舞。她回首望向步入露台的老师，眼角泪痣在月光下分外动人，流露出风华绝代的大家风范。
data.location: high wooden palace terrace surrounded by bamboo under full moon
data.action: standing near railing with folding fan, windblown ankle-length black hair, looking back
data.lighting: ethereal silver moonlight and warm hanging paper lantern glow
data.mood: breathtaking classical elegance and poetic romantic allure
data.promptProse: Under a full moon on a high palace terrace framed by bamboo, Sunohara Shun turns gracefully with a folding fan, her ankle-length black hair trailing in the cool breeze.
data.animaCaption: Shun looking back gracefully holding a folding fan on the moonlit bamboo terrace.
